wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on August 27, 2025 under Executive Order 13687, program tag DPRK2, for acting on behalf of the Government of North Korea

details.label: Role, per the Treasury
details.value: Russia-based DPRK economic and trade consular official

wanted_details.caution: Since at least December 2024, Andreyev has worked with Kim Ung Sun, a Russia-based DPRK economic and trade consular official, to facilitate multiple financial transfers worth a total of nearly $600,000, by converting cryptocurrency to cash in U.S. dollars. OFAC is designating Kim Ung Sun pursuant to E.O. 13687 for having acted or purporting to act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, the Government of North Korea.

sources.title: Recent Actions, August 27, 2025: North Korea Designations (Vitaliy Andreyev, Kim Ung Sun, Shenyang Geumpungri Network Technology, Korea Sinjin Trading)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions DPRK IT Worker Network

disclaimer: Kim Ung Sun is profiled here as the Russia-based DPRK consular official the Treasury says worked with Vitaliy Andreyev to move nearly $600,000 of Chinyong's IT-worker income from cryptocurrency into cash. OFAC prints the Hangul.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
